title: Under the lookup's down window a redirect hop into a host already in its window gets no request
goal: provider.gated_request reads the window only for the first url's host, so a redirect hop into a host already in its window is still requested and spends another TIMEOUT of the lookup budget (two sources on hosts A and C that both redirect to a firewalled B connect to B twice). Under provider.down_window a hop into a host in its window is refused as the first url would be, and recorded as no new failure. Found by the SP-srqmriw6 review of ST-k445avpw (its gate g3 chose record only, since the goal named only the recording).

run:
import sys,os,tempfile,threading,http.server
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
os.environ['no_proxy']='*'
os.environ['NO_PROXY']='*'
import provider
provider.DOWN_DIR=tempfile.mkdtemp()
provider.DELAY=0
hits=dict(a=0,b=0)
def mk(name,target):
    class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self):
            hits[name]+=1
            if target:
                self.send_response(302)
                self.send_header('Location',target())
                self.end_headers()
            else:
                self.send_response(200)
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(b'ok')
        def log_message(self,*a):
            pass
    s=http.server.HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),H)
    threading.Thread(target=s.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
    return s
sb=mk('b',None)
ub='http://127.0.0.1:%d/p'%sb.server_port
sa=mk('a',lambda:ub)
ua='http://127.0.0.1:%d/p'%sa.server_port
provider.host_seen(ub,'URLError: refused')
before=provider.host_down(ub)['count']
with provider.down_window():
    r=provider.gated_request(ua)
rec=provider.host_down(ub)
sys.exit(0 if hits['b']==0 and rec is not None and rec['count']==before else 1)
